description: This file defines CLI commands for managing plugins in the OpenClaw project, including listing, inspecting, enabling, disabling, uninstalling, installing, updating plugins, and interacting with plugin marketplaces.

methods.name: resolvePluginUninstallId
methods.description: Resolves a plugin ID or spec to a plugin record or ID, considering config and special cases.

methods.name: formatPluginLine
methods.description: Formats a plugin record into a string for listing, with optional verbose details.

methods.name: formatInspectSection
methods.description: Formats a section of plugin inspection details with a title.

methods.name: formatCapabilityKinds
methods.description: Joins capability kinds into a comma-separated string or returns '-' if none.

methods.name: formatHookSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for plugin hook usage based on legacy, typed, and custom hooks.

methods.name: formatInstallLines
methods.description: Formats installation record details into an array of strings.

methods.name: registerPluginsCli
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for plugin management, including list, inspect, enable, disable, uninstall, install, update, doctor, and marketplace commands.
